headline: Congress extended the Undetectable Firearms Act of 1988 for 10 more years, keeping its ban on guns that airport X-ray machines cannot detect.
what_it_does: The law extends the Undetectable Firearms Act of 1988 for 10 years. That act makes it illegal to make or possess a firearm that cannot be detected by the types of X-ray machines commonly used at airports. This measure does not change the ban itself, only how long it stays in effect.

who_it_affects.how: They remain barred from manufacturing firearms that airport-type X-ray machines cannot detect.

who_it_affects.group: People who own or possess firearms
who_it_affects.how: They remain barred from possessing firearms that airport-type X-ray machines cannot detect.

when_it_takes_effect: Took effect when enacted on December 9, 2013. The summary does not state the exact new expiration date.
